seasonalNotes: Major season planting peaks late March through May with the rains; minor season plant from September to October.
Fall armyworm pressure on maize is highest 4-8 weeks after emergence in the major season.
Cocoa black-pod disease accelerates during peak rainfall in June and October.
farmerFriendlyGuidance: Scout maize fields weekly for fall armyworm during the first 6 weeks after planting.
Stagger tomato planting so harvests overlap the dry-season market window.
Cover groundnut seed-stocks tightly to keep aflatoxin-producing molds out.
